clips.title: The story
paras: Delgren sends you north to meet Balthule Shadowstrike before the assault on Athrikus Narassin. The scout has watched the Tower of Althalaxx and can report what has changed there.

Delgren the Purifier sends you north to speak with Balthule Shadowstrike, his sentinel partner. You have purified corrupted relics and weakened the cult's hold along Darkshore's border. Before you confront the sorcerer Athrikus, Delgren wants fresh intelligence from Balthule, who has kept watch from the ruins overlooking the tower.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before confronting Athrikus, it would probably be wise for you to consult with Balthule. I have no doubt he has been vigilant in his watch of the Tower, and he may have information about recent developments.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, it's good to see you again, friend! The strangest things have been happening around here, I'm glad you showed up!

It was very strange, friend. Everything seemed normal—well, as normal as things get around here—and then suddenly there was a blinding flash of light from the upper room of the tower. Then came the screams. The cries split the air, and lightning struck the ground from time to time. What's going on?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
